title: Golden Hour Gallery Wall Set of 3, Mediterranean Summer Decor, Boho Neutral Wall Art, French Village Print, Ocean Sunset Digital Download
description:
Transform your space with this stunning 3-piece gallery wall set featuring a sun-drenched European village, a serene coastal sunset, and golden pampas grass. Bathed in warm, neutral peach and beige tones, this curated photography collection brings a sophisticated, sun-kissed Mediterranean aesthetic right to your home.

WHY YOU WILL LOVE IT:

• Instant Transformation — Instantly download, print, and frame these beautiful images to refresh your living room, bedroom, or office in minutes.

• Curated Cohesion — Designed to be displayed together, these three prints share a harmonious warm color palette that takes the guesswork out of styling.

• Endless Versatility — From boho chic to modern Mediterranean, these timeless, sunlit scenes seamlessly blend with any home decor style.

WHAT IS INCLUDED:

• High-Resolution Files — You will receive 3 high-quality, 300 DPI JPG files for each design, ensuring crisp and vibrant prints.

• Multiple Aspect Ratios — Files are scalable to fit over 20 standard frame sizes, making it easy to find the perfect frames for your space.

HOW TO PRINT /

USE:

• Download Immediately — Access your digital files right after purchase through your Etsy account or email receipt.

• Print Your Way — Print at home using high-quality cardstock, upload to an online printing service, or take the files to your local print shop.

PLEASE NOTE:

• Digital Download Only — This is a digital product; no physical items or frames will be shipped to your address.

• Color Variation — Colors may vary slightly due to different monitor displays, printer settings, and the type of paper used.

Thank you for visiting our shop! If you have any questions or custom requests, feel free to send us a message.
